title: SseFrame missing Clone; SseEvent and StateChange missing PartialEq
description: SseFrame derives Debug but not Clone. SseEvent derives Debug+Clone but not PartialEq. StateChange in push.rs derives Debug+Clone+Serialize+Deserialize but not PartialEq. Tests use match arms instead of == comparisons precisely because PartialEq is absent. Without Clone on SseFrame, callers cannot store or replay frames without consuming them. Without PartialEq on SseEvent/StateChange, unit tests must use match arms — a papercut for downstream consumers writing their own tests. Workspace pattern (jmap-types Id, State) derives both Clone and PartialEq on all data types.
